name: Spherical Beta View-Dependent Color
definition: A specular model that adds explicit specular lobes on top of the SH color, used for view-dependent color in PLY gaussian splats. It is the specular component from Deformable Beta Splatting (Liu et al., SIGGRAPH 2025).
summary: Spherical Beta View-Dependent Color adds explicit specular lobes to base color, offering higher PSNR and smaller file sizes than Spherical Harmonics.
